name: @insolvia-ai/tokens
//: Private and unpublished, unlike @insolvia-ai/design-system: consumers are
workspace members that resolve it by symlink, so there is nothing to
publish and no version-bump gate. `src/tokens.ts` is GENERATED by
tool/generate-tokens.ts — never hand-edit it; see README.md.
The export points at TypeScript source, not a build output. Metro (the
app) and Node >=24 (the generator, tests) both consume .ts directly, so a
compile step here would only add a way for the two to disagree.
